cases.original_question: Soluţia de racordare se stabileşte printr-o fişă de soluţie pentru:

original_ABC.B: utilizatorii de tip distribuitori, indiferent de tensiunea reţelei la care se racordează
original_ABC.C: locurile de consum care se racordează la reţele electrice de medie sau joasă tensiune, indiferent de puterea solicitată, dacă soluţia de racordare este unică şi/sau evidentă

rationale_by_alternative.A: Perturbing loads may require impact analysis through STUDIU, not always a solution sheet.
rationale_by_alternative.B: Users of distributor type are expressly STUDIU regardless of voltage under Art.15(b).
rationale_by_alternative.C: Art.12(c) explicitly says MV/LV individual consumption sites regardless requested power if connection solution unique and/or obvious.

exact_source.document: Ordin ANRE 102/2015 Regulament solution sheet/study (text mirror version from 06.09.2019)

cases.source_scope_and_2026_edition_gate: Historical 2015 regulation read, version at 2019 mirror; check current 2026 amendments and exact requested power versus other legal restrictions before certification.

cases.original_question: Fişa de soluţie este elaborată de:

original_ABC.C: orice proiectant de specialitate (societate comercială atestată pentru activităţi de proiectare)

rationale_by_alternative.A: The applicant user provides data, but does not own legal approval/elaboration of solution sheet.
rationale_by_alternative.B: Operator of network receiving application is responsible for elaboration; Art.14 says the network operator prepares and validates the sheet.
rationale_by_alternative.C: A contracted specialist may help with studies in specifically permitted conditions, but not ANY specialist unrestrictedly elaborating the regulatory solution sheet.

exact_source.document: Ordin ANRE 102/2015 Regulament solution sheet/study (text mirror version from 06.09.2019)

cases.source_scope_and_2026_edition_gate: Verb 'elaborată' matches specific Art.14; prior Reg59 Art17 merely 'stabilește' was topic-adjacent, not sufficient. Specific-source blocker superseded.

cases.original_question: Soluţia de racordare se stabileşte printr-o fişă de soluţie pentru:

original_ABC.A: locurile de consum individuale ale utilizatorilor de tip clienţi casnici, indiferent de puterea solicitată
original_ABC.B: locurile de consum şi/sau de producere care se racordează la reţele electrice având tensiunea nominală de 110 kV sau mai mare;
original_ABC.C: utilizatorii de tip distribuitori, indiferent de tensiunea reţelei la care se racordează

rationale_by_alternative.A: Art.12(a) explicitly assigns individual domestic user consumption locations to solution sheet regardless requested power.
rationale_by_alternative.B: Network >=110kV expressly in STUDIU Art.15(a), not sheet.
rationale_by_alternative.C: Distributor users regardless voltage expressly in STUDIU Art.15(b).

exact_source.document: Ordin ANRE 102/2015 Regulament solution sheet/study (text mirror version from 06.09.2019)

cases.source_scope_and_2026_edition_gate: Domestic special cases still subject to overall connection feasibility and later amendment review; the old article has this literal phrase.

cases.original_question: Soluţia de racordare se stabileşte printr-un studiu de soluţie pentru:

original_ABC.A: locurile de consum individuale ale utilizatorilor de tip clienţi casnici, indiferent de puterea solicitată
original_ABC.B: utilizatorii de tip distribuitori, indiferent de tensiunea reţelei la care se racordează
original_ABC.C: utilizatorii cu o putere de peste 25 kVA

rationale_by_alternative.A: Domestic individual consumers are in FIȘĂ via Art.12(a), not universally in study.
rationale_by_alternative.B: Distributor type users of any voltage categorically in STUDIU by Art.15(b).
rationale_by_alternative.C: A power above 25kVA by itself is not a universal study trigger: Art.12(c) allows sheet for unique/evident MV/LV solutions regardless power.

exact_source.document: Ordin ANRE 102/2015 Regulament solution sheet/study (text mirror version from 06.09.2019)

cases.source_scope_and_2026_edition_gate: Requires 2015-2019 versus 2026 exact version check of source act; this result is provisional.

cases.original_question: Reţeaua electrică a operatorului de transport/distribuţie

original_ABC.A: constituie două surse de alimentare pentru locul de consum respectiv, dacă acesta este racordat  printr-un post de transformare alimentat din două stații de treanformare, echipat cu două transformatoare și instalație de AAR
original_ABC.B: constituie două surse de alimentare pentru locul de consum respectiv, dacă acesta este racordat  printr-un post de transformare echipat cu două transformatoare și instalație de AAR
original_ABC.C: constituie o singură sursă de alimentare (SEN) pentru locul de consum respectiv, indiferent de numărul de instalaţii electrice prin care este racordat

rationale_by_alternative.A: Even two feeding substations, transformers and AAR do not convert the operator's external network into two independent supply sources for this site.
rationale_by_alternative.B: Two transformers with AAR still connect to the same operator network, not two separately counted supply sources under Art.20(d).
rationale_by_alternative.C: Art.20(d): regardless number of electrical connection installations, same operator electricity network is ONE supply source for site.

exact_source.document: Ordin ANRE 102/2015 Regulament solution sheet/study (text mirror version from 06.09.2019)

cases.source_scope_and_2026_edition_gate: Exact object is independent supply source classification for operator's network, different from counts of feeders. Historical article and later legal edition should be independently verified.
